name: of1-budget-savings-calculator
description: A how-much-you-save layout with a headline savings figure, a today-vs-Xfinity line-item comparison, and a bundle-savings highlight.

slots.instruction: Short kicker above the headline framing the savings story.
Headline promising the visitor a clear savings outcome with Xfinity.
One-sentence summary of the today-vs-Xfinity comparison shown below.
The single big headline savings amount, for example a first-year dollar figure.
Short note explaining what the headline savings figure represents.
Primary hero call to action linking to the shop or order flow.
Heading introducing the today-versus-Xfinity line-item comparison.
Column label for what the visitor pays today.
Column label for what the visitor pays with Xfinity.
Name of the first cost line, such as home internet.
What the visitor pays today for the first line item.
What the visitor pays with Xfinity for the first line item.
Monthly savings on the first line item.
Name of the second cost line, such as a mobile line.
What the visitor pays today for the second line item.
What the visitor pays with Xfinity for the second line item.
Monthly savings on the second line item.
Name of the third cost line, such as streaming apps.
What the visitor pays today for the third line item.
What the visitor pays with Xfinity for the third line item.
Monthly savings on the third line item.
Label for the combined monthly total row.
Combined amount the visitor pays today across all line items.
Combined amount the visitor pays with Xfinity across all line items.
Combined monthly savings across all line items.
Kicker introducing the bundle-savings highlight.
Heading for the bundle-savings highlight section.
Paragraph describing how bundling mobile increases the savings.
Bulleted list of bundle savings benefits.
Call to action to explore the bundle or mobile savings.
Supporting image for the bundle highlight. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Heading introducing where the savings come from.
List of reasons that explain how the savings add up.
Closing call-to-action heading.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to check availability or start the order.
